text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Thursday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Four ministers in the new cabinet - Roberts Zile (finance), Valdis Birkavs (foreign affairs), Ramona Umblija (culture) and Andris Ravins (agriculture), have not yet confirmed their conformity to the anti-corruption law by signing a special declaratio.

- The prosecutor's office said parliamentary speaker Alfreds Chepanis exceeded his powers when he agreed to delay the removal of the remains of Russian warships and submarines from the harbours in Liepaja and Bolderaja.
Since his actions posed no danger to the public, no further legal action will be taken against him.
- The court of arbitration in Moscow has ruled that the correspondent accounts of Latvia's Parex Bank should be freed. Russian tax authorites froze them late last month.
- The government has set up a committee to co-ordinate the fight against drug abuse headed by Interior Minister Ziedonis Chevers.
